title: A localized Gaussian-witness lower bound for fractional iterated area on uniform grids
accepted_scope: For every H∈(1/4,1), T>0, n≥1 and independent standard fractional Brownian components, every square-integrable estimator based on both components at jT/n has RMS error≥c_H T^(2H)n^(1/2-2H) for the canonical ∫B1dB2, c_H>0.
limitations: No original lower-bound-target gap asserted. Rough range (1/4,1/2) is candidate new residual; Brownian optimum and smooth-range asymptotic rate are credited. No sharp constant, normalized limit, endpoints, arbitrary mesh or adaptive sampling claimed.
